messages:
oncall-bot: 🚨 Incident INC-2024-1718004321 created: Multiple runtimes OOMs detected on cluster-gpu-1 (gpu-17/gpu-18). Auto-alert from runtime-monitor.
maria: seeing repeated container exits (137) on gpu-17 around 02:12 UTC, suspected paged-attn/KV cache growth.
devin: quick log snippet: ```2024-06-12T02:12:41Z runtime ERR: cudaErrorMemoryAllocation: out of memory
2024-06-12T02:12:42Z runtime INFO: container restart (exit=137)
2024-06-12T02:12:43Z runtime WARN: KV cache high-water 95%
```
infra-bot: node metrics: https://grafana/redwood/d/gpu-cluster?var-node=gpu-17 — persistent memory usage creep on runcgroup:serving-runtime. Paged allocator fragmentation track rising.
maria: customer-facing queue spike for /v1/generate on long-context models, errors ~0.8% cluster-wide but 5% on gpu-17. Most traffic rerouted by smart-router but some requests hit pinned capacity.
ops-cs: Customer-impact check: affected customers: corp-alpha (briefly degraded), media-inc (timeouts for >8k tokens). No full outage, but SLA error window from 02:11-02:20 UTC. Notifying CS.
sam: first mitigation: cordon gpu-17 and gpu-18, drain non-critical workloads, re-route traffic to dedicated pool. Also trigger cache compaction job and run a manual kv-sweep.
maria: running kv-sweep on node gpu-17 now: ```sudo /opt/redwood/bin/kv-sweep --node gpu-17 --mode=live --target=compact```
devin: compaction started, progress log: "compact: phase1 freeable=1.2GB phase2 defrag=0.6GB". Starting to see allocation dip.
infra-bot: note: paging IO spiked during compaction — watch latency. If IO > 200ms we'll pause.
maria: saw one CUDA OOM with stack (alloc 512MB failed) then runtime recovered after compaction freed ~900MB. Still seeing small leak over ~20m.
sam: temporary config change: lowering KV cache warmup from 60s->20s on affected nodes to reduce prefetch footprint. Applying to gpu-17 group.
devin: change applied to gpu-17, rolling. Also enabled fallback to quantized model variant for requests >6k tokens to reduce memory footprint. Router rule pushed.
ops-cs: CS update posted: "We detected increased generation errors for long contexts on some customers between 02:11-02:20 UTC. Mitigations applied, impact reduced. Working on root cause."
maria: recommended follow-ups: 1) schedule offline compaction across cluster, 2) add eviction jitter to avoid synchronized warmup, 3) add KV cache leak metric (per-runtime delta over 5m).
sam: created follow-up ticket INFRA-4932 to track leak metric + long-term compaction cadence.
alex: taking handoff for nightwatch, ack. My immediate plan: monitor gpu-17/gpu-18 for 2h, keep compaction running, escalate if >1% error + restart frequency >3 in 15m.
maria: handing off logs and commands to alex: pastebin link https://internal/paste/abcd — includes crashdump and nvstack traces.
alex: ack, will monitor and chill traffic if needed.
oncall-bot: incident status updated -> mitigation in progress; severity lowered to S2 (customer impact limited).
ops-cs: final note: no broad customer outage, targeted degradation only; customer ops will follow up with corp-alpha and media-inc after final postmortem.
alex: closing loop here, will add notes to INC ticket and leave monitoring playbook running. If any reoccurrence ping me @alex. :thumbsup:
